description: Renovation of Sahaspura Housing Scheme, Baseline Road, Borella and Sinhapura Flats Housing Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to proceed with the activities of the above at a cost of Rs. 75.96 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
